name: Later: time, panner, world-position and fresnel nodes, runtime parameters
body: After the first slices: a time uniform and `mat_time`/`mat_panner` nodes, world-position and fresnel nodes, parameters that a game changes at run time (material instances), per-material opacity or masked materials, and a Nyx gap card if Nyx needs anything to drive them.

comments.text: Done on PR #220: mat_time, mat_panner, mat_world_position, mat_fresnel and mat_sine nodes; an opacity mask output (discard below 0.5); normal maps follow their own coordinate (normal_uv); mat_param values ride in the per-draw material uniforms and lantern:::world:::SetMaterialParameter changes them at run time. Samples neon_pulse, lava_flow, vent_grille. Decision D-264. Still open: translucency, masked shadows, per-piece parameter values. No Nyx gap needed.
